Name: Beach Additional Storage Space Area
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][size=5]This mod works on its own, but it is strongly recommended to use “[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11594]Beach Extension For Crab Pod[/url]” at the same time.
This mod was originally designed to be used in combination with “[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11594]Beach Extension For Crab Pod[/url]”, so it has been optimized.[/size][/quote]
[size=3]Add a new location accessible from the pier.
There is a reasonable space where you can put various things.
Seagulls can be seen in the summer.

The appearance can be changed from mod config.

Mod configurations and objects that can be examined are available in English, Japanese and Chinese and French.
